Subject: Pipeline sanitation: monthly scrub & exec pack routing

Team —

Quick kickoff for this month’s pipeline sanitation (monthly scrub). Goal: get the commit list locked, hand off the leadership review packet, and route any accounts that need an exec-level readout. Rough timeline below. Please treat this as the canonical source for who is owning what this week.

What I’ve attached:
- pipeline_sanitization_matrix.xlsx (master stage/status + owner column)
- exec_pack_template_v2.pptx (leadership slide templates and account highlight guidance)

Timeline / asks:
- By Tue 2027-05-04 EOD: update the matrix with any stage changes, commit status, and two-line reason for movement. Flag any accounts requiring an exec slide (column: "Exec Pack?").
- Wed 2027-05-05 by noon: I’ll collect flagged accounts and draft the leadership packet.
- Fri 2027-05-06 EOD: final packet uploaded to the Drive link below and distributed to execs.

Priority guidance:
- Only mark a commit if you have a documented customer yes and finance confirmation (or clear next-step).
- Conservative stage moves if there is outstanding legal/procurement. Don’t promote to Commit just from a verbal promise.

Ownership:
- Laura: review all Stage 4/5 deals and confirm finance readiness (billing/PO status).
- Grace: take the top 6 ARR deals for detailed slide write-ups.
- Karthik: QC top-of-funnel stage shifts against recent SDR notes.
- Neha: reconcile any regional tax/contract exceptions.
- I’ll assemble the exec pack and handle routing + any escalation notes.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/drive/folders/finance/pipeline-sanitization-2027-05

Thanks — keep updates short in the matrix so we can roll them into slides.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
